title: Small Laundry Room Ideas: Closets, Stackables & Storage
h1: Small Laundry Room Ideas: Storage, Layouts and Makeovers for Closets and Apartments
description: Small laundry room ideas for closets and apartments: stackable washer dryer clearances, storage that fits, folding surfaces, paint finishes and renter tips.
excerpt: Make a tiny laundry room or stackable closet work harder with smart storage, a folding surface, the right paint finish and renter-friendly upgrades.
image_alt: Small laundry room with stacked washer and dryer, shelves above and matching storage containers
key_takeaways: Measure the closet opening as well as the interior, and allow space behind the machines for hoses and venting.
Use the wall above stacked units and the gaps beside them before buying floor storage.
Decant detergents into matching containers to cut visual clutter on open shelves.
Mount a folding countertop on wall cleats about 1 inch above front-loaders, not resting on them.
Choose satin or semi-gloss paint and bright, high-CRI lighting for a hardworking laundry space.

faq.q: How wide does a closet need to be for a stackable washer and dryer?
faq.a: For full-size 27-inch stacked machines, plan on a closet about 32 to 33 inches wide and 32 to 36 inches deep, plus room behind for hoses and the vent. Compact 24-inch stacked units can fit in roughly 27 to 30 inches of width. Always check your models' installation guides.

faq.q: How can I add storage to a small laundry room?
faq.a: Add shelves or a wall cabinet above the machines, a slim rolling cart in the gap beside them, a hanging rod or retractable line for drip-dry items, and an over-the-door pocket organizer. Decant detergents into matching containers to save space and reduce visual clutter.

faq.q: Can you put a dryer in a closet?
faq.a: Yes, many dryers can be installed in closets, but they need adequate airflow. Manufacturers often specify louvered doors or minimum vent openings, especially for gas dryers. If venting outside is not possible, ventless heat pump or condenser dryers are designed for closet installations.

faq.q: What paint finish is best for a laundry room?
faq.a: Satin or semi-gloss is usually best because it wipes clean and handles humidity and splashes better than flat paint. Look for a scrubbable formula. Light colors brighten a dim closet, while deep colors look rich and hide scuffs if the space is well lit.

faq.q: How do I make a laundry closet look nicer in an apartment?
faq.a: Add peel-and-stick wallpaper, plug-in LED lighting, a freestanding over-the-washer shelf and matching storage containers. Replace awkward doors with a curtain if needed, keeping the originals. These changes are reversible, easy to undo before moving out, and typically cost a few hundred dollars or less.
